saintapediagraph-desc: Saintapedia Graph — Mermaid org charts and funding networks from Extension:Cargo data
saintapediagraph-error-missing-tables: Saintapedia Graph: the "tables" parameter is required (or use nodes_table + edges_table for dual mode).
saintapediagraph-error-missing-edge-fiel: Saintapedia Graph: edge diagrams need both "source_field" and "target_field".
saintapediagraph-error-missing-mode: Saintapedia Graph: specify a mode — parent_field (hierarchy), source_field+target_field (edges), or nodes_table+edges_table (dual).
saintapediagraph-error-mixed-modes: Saintapedia Graph: do not mix parent_field with source_field/target_field. Use hierarchy, edge, or dual mode only.
saintapediagraph-error-missing-dual-tabl: Saintapedia Graph: dual mode requires both "nodes_table" and "edges_table".
saintapediagraph-error-dual-needs-params: Saintapedia Graph: dual mode must be invoked via buildFromParams (nodes_table + edges_table), not raw rows alone.
saintapediagraph-error-no-cargo: Saintapedia Graph: Extension:Cargo is required but was not found.
saintapediagraph-error-no-results: Saintapedia Graph: the query returned no rows to graph.
saintapediagraph-error-expensive: Saintapedia Graph: too many expensive parser functions on this page; remove some graphs or raise $wgExpensiveParserFunctionLimit.
saintapediagraph-error-render: Saintapedia Graph: failed to render diagram.
saintapediagraph-warning-cycles: Saintapedia Graph: detected $1 directed cycle(s) in the graph. Use break_cycles=yes to remove cycle-closing edges.
saintapediagraph-warning-cycles-broken: Saintapedia Graph: removed $1 edge(s) to break directed cycle(s).
